description: Addendum M6 — PR1 is NOT behaviour-neutral for a SOLO character with own house rules: priceOf(cur,"drawback",{v}) now returns the own house-ruled value (here a custom drawback "Bad Luck Charm" worth 4) instead of reading DATA alone, which stamped a custom drawback at cost 0 and gave it a free buy-off. This log is what the Live Sheet now records (cost -4): the frozen ledger (economy().drawbackEarned 4) and compute()'s grant agree. The priceOf/buy-off quote halves are asserted in testing/scripts/house-rules-ledger-ci.mjs.

Bad Luck Charm.fx: Once per session the DM may reroll one of your d20s.
